mapper.select: select NVL(sum(lo.quantity * p.price), 0) as total_revenue, NVL(sum(lo.quantity), 0) as total_quantity, case when sum(lo.quantity) > 0 then round(sum(lo.quantity * p.price) / sum(lo.quantity), 0) else 0 end as avg_price from lot_out lo join outbound_detail obd on lo.outbound_detail_id = obd.outbound_detail_id join product p on obd.product_id = p.product_id where lo.is_expired= 'N'

select p.product_name, sum(lo.quantity) as quantity, sum(lo.quantity * p.price) as revenue from lot_out lo join outbound_detail obd on lo.outbound_detail_id = obd.outbound_detail_id join product p on obd.product_id = p.product_id where lo.is_expired = 'N' group by p.product_name order by revenue desc
